faces.name: Tenuous Truce
faces.oracleText:
Enchant opponent
At the beginning of enchanted opponent's end step, you and that player each draw a card.
When you attack enchanted opponent or a planeswalker they control or when they attack you or a planeswalker you control, sacrifice this Aura.

faces.name: Tenured Concocter
faces.oracleText:
Vigilance
Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw a card.
Infusion — This creature gets +2/+0 as long as you gained life this turn.

faces.name: Tenured Inkcaster
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

faces.name: Tenured Oilcaster
faces.oracleText:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
This creature gets +3/+0 as long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, each player mills a card.

faces.name: Tenured Tethermage
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a land. If you do, create two tapped Heartwood tokens. (They're red and green artifacts with "{T}: Add {R} or {G}.")
Tap two untapped artifacts you control: Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
